senses.gloss: मुद् múd, f. joy, delight, gladness (sts. pl.).
मुद्ग mud-gá, m. kind of kidney-bean (Phaseolus 🞄Mungo: the plant and the seed).

मुद्गर mud-gara, m. hammer;
 hammer-like 🞄weapon: -ka, —˚ a. (i-kā) hammer.
मुद्गल múd-gala, m. [shouting for joy], N., 🞄esp. of a Ṛṣi.

मुद्रित mudr-ita, pp. of mudraya;
 n. impressing 🞄a seal on (lc.).
